description: Structured research results for Organization discovery and full assessment. The same question-result structure is used at both stages.

question_results.description: One result for every question supplied in questions.json. Preserve the supplied question identity, wording, category and sequence.

question_id.description: Exact identifier supplied for the question in questions.json. Never create or modify this identifier.

question.description: Exact question wording supplied by CRM.

question_type.description: Exact question type supplied by CRM.

ai_rating.description: Rating compatible with the CRM Rating field and the question's configured type. For close-ended binary questions, use 1 for a verified positive and 0 for a verified negative. Use null when evidence is insufficient to determine a rating.

ai_supporting_evidence.description: Concise explanation of the finding, including relevant facts, dates and reasoning. Clearly distinguish company-reported claims from independently corroborated findings.

discovery_qualification.description: Discovery-stage disposition for this question, where applicable. Use null for full assessment.

overall_finding.description: Concise summary of the research findings for this stage.

qualification_score.description: Discovery qualification score, if calculated under the supplied run configuration. Do not invent a scoring formula.

qualification_threshold.description: Threshold supplied in run_context.json. Return null if not applicable.

mandatory_negative_found.description: True only when at least one mandatory criterion has a verified negative finding.

mandatory_negative_questions.description: Question identifiers for mandatory criteria with verified negative findings.

insufficient_evidence_questions.description: Question identifiers for which available evidence is insufficient.

discovered_sources.description: Credible reusable sources newly identified during this research, deduplicated by canonical URL. Return an empty array when none qualify.

source_id.description: Temporary unique identifier, also used by evidence_references when this source is cited.

applicable_territories.description: Exact CRM Territory identities; empty for global sources.

applicable_assessment_categories.description: Exact CRM Assessment Category identities; empty for generic sources.

relevance.description: Concise explanation of the source’s relevance.

validation_rules: Return exactly one question result for every question supplied in questions.json.
Do not add, remove, merge, reorder or rewrite assessment questions.
Preserve question_id, assessment_category, question, question_type, close_ended and mandatory exactly as supplied.
The question_results array must follow the same sequence as the supplied assessment template.
Use only the configured question type and CRM rating semantics. Do not invent rating scales or answer options.
For close-ended binary questions, use ai_rating 1 for a verified positive and 0 for a verified negative. Use null when evidence is insufficient.
Insufficient evidence must never be treated as a verified negative.
A mandatory criterion disqualifies a candidate only when its negative finding is supported by evidence.
A mandatory criterion with insufficient evidence requires further research or human review; it is not automatically a disqualification.
The discovery qualification score and threshold must follow the run configuration. Do not invent a formula or threshold.
Discovery and full assessment must use the same question-result structure. Research depth and stage-specific fields may differ.
Every factual finding must be supported by evidence references where sources are available. Do not fabricate sources, URLs, dates or source identifiers.
Return null for unavailable optional values rather than guessing.
Do not return or modify human-controlled CRM fields such as rating, evidence_status, confidence, supporting_evidence, accept_ai, score or final_score.
Return discovered_sources for both DISCOVERY and FULL_ASSESSMENT. Use an empty array when no qualifying new sources are found.

Include only credible, reusable sources absent from the complete source_catalogue.json; absence from the selected research_plan.json alone is not sufficient. Deduplicate by canonical URL and use exact CRM Territory and Assessment Category identities where applicable.
Each discovered source_id must be unique and must match the same source_id used in question_results[].evidence_references when that discovered source is cited.

description: Proposed CRM Organization master-data values for a newly researched organization. This is separate from the assessment question results.

currency.description: CRM Currency value, if reliably established and available in supplied CRM reference data.

exchange_rate.description: Populate only when the applicable rate is supplied or reliably established under the CRM process. Otherwise null.

territory.description: Must match an allowed CRM Territory value supplied in crm_reference_data.json.

industry.description: Must match an allowed CRM Industry value supplied in crm_reference_data.json.

address_type.description: Must match an allowed CRM Address Type value supplied in crm_reference_data.json.

field_evidence.description: One evidence record for every proposed Organization field with a non-null value.

source_references.description: Source IDs from the research evidence.

identity_and_relationship_notes.description: Clarify legal entity identity, parent/subsidiary relationships, trading names and potential duplicate records.

validation_rules: Return only fields represented in the supplied Organization contract and CRM reference data.
Do not invent values to complete CRM fields. Use null when information is unavailable or cannot be established reliably.
Every non-null proposed Organization field must have a corresponding field_evidence record.
Use exact CRM Link values from crm_reference_data.json for fields such as territory, industry, currency and address_type. Do not create new Link values.
Do not invent an exchange rate. Use only a supplied or reliably established value under the applicable CRM process.
Distinguish legal entities, parent companies, subsidiaries, brands and trading names. Do not combine separate legal entities into one Organization record.
Do not return a CRM document name, CRM ID or other identifier unless it was explicitly supplied.
The Organization payload is proposed master data, not an instruction to create or update a CRM record.
The research agent must not write directly to CRM.
